name: Compute Network Backbone
summary: Extracts the backbone of a weighted structural or functional connectivity network with the disparity filter (Serrano et al. 2009) using networkx and igraph, keeping only statistically significant edges.
description: Loads the first network from a JGF network file, computes a disparity-filter significance score (alpha) for every weighted edge and keeps edges whose alpha is below the alpha parameter, saving the backbone as output/network.json.gz. Use it to sparsify dense connectivity matrices before network analysis; edges at nodes with a single connection never pass the cut in the undirected case.

inputs.description: Weighted network in JGF format (network.json.gz); only the first network in the file is used.

outputs.description: Backbone network (network.json.gz) containing only the edges that pass the disparity-filter threshold.

parameters.description: Disparity-filter significance threshold: an edge is kept when its alpha score is below this value (smaller keeps fewer edges).

citations.text: Serrano MA, Boguna M, Vespignani A. Extracting the multiscale backbone of complex weighted networks. PNAS 106(16):6483-6488 (2009).
